title: Synthetic Tax Data Generation Guide
summary: A documentation-only guide describing methods for generating synthetic U.S. individual tax return data, including detailed code walkthroughs for modeling variable correlations and enforcing tax-rule constraints. The guide's primary technique uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and constraints API alongside the standalone copulas package's VineCopula for non-linear dependencies.
